rlsYankemToggle.onDown: if not extensions.rlsYankem then extensions.load('rlsYankem') end; if extensions.rlsYankem then extensions.rlsYankem.toggleWinch() end
rlsYankemToggle.title: Project Yankem: Winch / Cancel / Disconnect
rlsYankemToggle.desc: Enter winch selection, cancel selection, or disconnect the active Yankem cable

rlsYankemReelIn.onDown: if not extensions.rlsYankem then extensions.load('rlsYankem') end; if extensions.rlsYankem then extensions.rlsYankem.setReelDirection(-1) end
rlsYankemReelIn.title: Project Yankem: Reel In
rlsYankemReelIn.desc: Retract the active Yankem cable while held

rlsYankemReelOut.onDown: if not extensions.rlsYankem then extensions.load('rlsYankem') end; if extensions.rlsYankem then extensions.rlsYankem.setReelDirection(1) end
rlsYankemReelOut.title: Project Yankem: Reel Out
rlsYankemReelOut.desc: Pay out the active Yankem cable while held

rlsYankemSelect.title: Project Yankem: Select Winch Point
rlsYankemSelect.desc: Select the hovered Yankem attachment point while Winch Mode is active
